name: Azariah Horton
bioAdditions: Akerly (S1) lists him among the six children of Jonathan Horton and Mary Tuthill (m. 27 Nov 1705), noting he was a Yale graduate, missionary to the Long Island Indians, and ancestor of Rev. Theodore L. Cuyler. Routes: 1st cousin 9 times removed via John Tuthill Jr & Mehitable Wells; also 2C9R via William Wells through his grandmother Bethia (Wells) Horton.

sources.citation: Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), p. 8
sources.supports: Mary Tuthill m. Jonathan Horton; children incl. Azariah, Yale, missionary, ancestor of Cuyler

researchLogEntry: Round 4: Akerly confirms parentage; second route via Wells added.
